product.title: Welcome to Seattle Walking Tour with Monorail Ride

description.text: Get oriented to Seattle on a guided walking tour through downtown and Pioneer Square, plus a scenic ride on the historic Seattle Monorail. A local guide introduces major neighborhoods, city history, and landmark viewpoints in a few hours.

highlights: Ride on the historic Seattle Monorail
Explore Pioneer Square and downtown corridors

start.description: Meet at 100 Yesler Way, Seattle, WA 98104 in Pioneer Square.

end.description: Tour ends near Seattle Center at 472 1st Ave N.

product.itinerarySummary: Get oriented to Seattle on a guided walking tour through downtown and Pioneer Square, plus a scenic ride on the historic Seattle Monorail.

itineraryItems.title: Pioneer Square
itineraryItems.description: Begin in Pioneer Square with an overview of Seattle founding history and architecture.

itineraryItems.title: Downtown Seattle
itineraryItems.description: Walk through central districts with commentary on neighborhoods and city landmarks.

itineraryItems.title: Seattle Monorail
itineraryItems.description: Ride the historic monorail linking downtown to Seattle Center for skyline perspectives.

itineraryItems.title: Seattle Center
itineraryItems.description: Arrive near the Space Needle and Seattle Center campus to finish the orientation route.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Welcome to Seattle Walking Tour with Monorail Ride?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 2 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Seattle?
faqs.answer: Meet at 100 Yesler Way, Seattle, WA 98104 in Pioneer Square.
